notes: *the banqueting house* is the construct chain with its rectum rendered attributively and anarthrously (rule 28), so the phrase's single *the* is fronted from the rectum's article under rule 29 and the construct keeps only *house*.
עָלַי heads an adjunct rather than the predicate, so the copula joins the nominal predicate אַהֲבָה under rule 49's closing paragraph.
